This plot is very small, only a tiny corner near the house, and I grow mixed things on it together — some vegetables and maybe a bit of beans with something else. Since I have other bigger plots, I save my fertilizer bag for the main fields where maize and teff grow; this small piece I feed with the manure from my animals and the kitchen ash. I use my own seed that I kept from last year, and I weed it myself when I come back from the bigger plots. My husband and children help a little, but mostly it is my hands on this plot.
